desert1:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the head/face cloth on these seated pixel-art RPG sprites. The user's correction: these people wear continuous desert TURBAN WRAPS winding around both the head AND lower face. The old images incorrectly look like a separate triangular bandana or face mask tied beneath a hat.
Make the turban's same cloth visibly travel from the crown down beside the cheeks, wrap in overlapping HORIZONTAL FOLDS around nose/mouth/chin, and connect back to the head wrap with a draped tail. An open strip exposes the eyes and some brow. No isolated mask, no triangular bandana front, no ear loops, no exposed gap separating headwrap from facewrap. The principal turban color must continue across the lower face. Retain the former contrasting neck scarf color as a small accent UNDER the turban at the collar only.
Keep each person's exact skin, eye shape/position, gender/age/species, proportions, seated pose, clothing below neck, crisp pixel rendering and palette. Do not make new identities. Vela's pointed green ears may extend through the side of the wrap.
OUTPUT: 4 columns, 5 rows, same residents in same row order. Columns rest/open eyes, subtle inhale/open eyes with identical face, half blink, completely closed eyelids. Pixel grid, all frames same alignment and size, consistent faces/hair/clothes except the specified fabric correction. No labels or text. Fully transparent background with ample clear space around every sprite. No chairs/tables/ground. No gradients/blur/antialiasing. No backdrop.
